[IRET.16.2] **Per-node atom shapes** (`proto/{alfa,beta,term}.proto`) —
each node is its own atom keyed by a `node_id`:

The three node messages are `proto/alfa.proto#AlphaNode`, `proto/beta.proto#BetaNode` and `proto/term.proto#TerminalNode`. [RDSC.4a.6] and its siblings tie the DSC format to the same messages; this clause does not restate them ([STYL.2.15.5]).
